evidence_snippets: How does it work You can use Custom Speech-to-Text models to augment a base transcription model to improve transcription recognition.
Custom Speech-to-Text models help you fine-tune speech recognition models to your specific needs.

evidence_snippets: Similar to machine-learning models, training a Custom Speech-to-Text model is typically iterative and involves selecting a base model as a starting point, fine-tuning it with your text and audio datasets, then testing the recognition quality of the model.
List your custom models By selecting the Models in the Custom Models section, you can also list all of your Custom Speech-to-Text models, including the ones that are training, active, and deleting.
